subject.title: fix(onboarding): stop recommending tools setup cannot activate

question: Should the no-inference onboarding catalog contain only tools that guided setup can detect, verify, and persist as an inference route?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but removing five supported-tool discovery cards chooses the permanent meaning of a shared CLI, macOS, and Control UI product surface.

options.title: Use guided-only recommendations
options.body: Confirm that the catalog is an actionable recovery list and merge the four-entry policy after the direct Codex contract check.

options.title: Preserve broader discovery
options.body: Keep broader tool visibility but redesign the metadata and UI so advanced provider or ACP routes are clearly separated from install-and-check-again candidates.

recommendation.title: Use guided-only recommendations
recommendation.body: Confirm that the catalog is an actionable recovery list and merge the four-entry policy after the direct Codex contract check.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history shows this person introduced the catalog and its cross-client onboarding semantics.
